jobs.description:
Perhaps you found this vacancy thanks to our software? Because that’s what theMatchBox does: we build smart search engines that match the right job with the right candidate – or vice versa. By making clever use of a whole range of artificial intelligence tools – such as natural language processing, ontologies and large language models – we take into account spelling variations, typos, synonyms, context and everything else needed to compile, in a transparent manner, a list of matching jobs and candidates that is as accurate and comprehensive as possible.
 

theMatchBox is part of the Pixid Group and is a fast-growing HR tech scale-up with clients including staffing agencies, job sites and major employers both at home and abroad. Do you enjoy getting to grips with complex issues and would you like to play your part in improving the functioning of the labour market? Then come and join our team, as we could really do with your help.
 

Your tasks will be very varied. You’ll work on the API and the architecture of our matching software. In consultation with our account managers, you’ll integrate our software with the client’s systems so that all necessary data becomes searchable in our matching engine. Together with the client, you’ll determine which aspects of a job or candidate are important to them when making a match and configure our software accordingly. Finally, you’ll be part of our support team or resolve build issues… Everything is done in close collaboration and consultation with the team, and you’re always welcome to pop in and see us.

Your tasks will be very diverse. You will contribute to the API and the architecture of our matching software. In consultation with our account managers, you will integrate our software at the client's site so that all necessary data becomes searchable in our matching engine. Together with the client, you will determine which aspects of a job or candidate are important to them for a match and configure our software accordingly. Finally, you will work within our support system or fix build issues… Everything is done in close collaboration and consultation with the team, and you can always come to us with your ideas.
 

What do we expect from you? 
• You have a thorough knowledge of Java, 
• You have experience designing or maintaining a software architecture, 
• You enjoy navigating our complex software and algorithms, 
• You are interested in search engines and artificial intelligence, 
• When programming, you value accuracy, quality, and security, 
• You enjoy working independently (we will, of course, help you get started), 
• You can communicate clearly with clients and colleagues, 
• You can express yourself well in English.
 

What is not necessary but is nice to have? 
• Experience with Docker, Elasticsearch, 
• Experience deploying LLMs on GPUs, 
• Building software with Maven and Jenkins, 
• Managing servers with Ansible.

As a Laser Operator, you will operate advanced laser cutting machines used to cut metal sheets and tubes to specification. You will monitor the quality of the production process and ensure operations run safely and efficiently.

Your responsibilities:

 
• Setting up and operating laser cutting machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Performing quality checks on finished components.
 
• Identifying and resolving minor machine issues.
 
• Contributing to a safe and organized workplace.

 
• You have a technical education or a strong interest in technology.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.

As a Press Brake Operator, you will be responsible for accurately bending metal parts based on technical drawings. You ensure that every component meets the required quality standards.

Your tasks:

• Making minor adjustments where necessary.
 
• Maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

 
• You have a technical background or a strong technical affinity.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

Service Technician 
 

Are you someone who enjoys solving technical problems and helping customers? Do you like working independently while also contributing ideas for improvements and new technical projects? Then this opportunity could be the right fit for you.
 

For a company based in the 
Roeselare region, we are looking for a Service Technician who enjoys a varied role. You will work in a technical environment where maintenance, installations, troubleshooting, and project work go hand in hand.
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 

• Diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical failures at customer sites. 

• Perform preventive maintenance on a variety of technical installations. 

• Assist with the installation and commissioning of new systems. 

• Contribute to technical improvements and new projects. 

• Act as a point of contact for customers and provide technical advice when needed. 

• Ensure proper follow-up and after-sales support following completed work.  

You will work on a range of systems, including:
 
 

• Water treatment and irrigation installations such as pumps, valves, and PVC piping systems. 

• Mechanical and hydraulic installations. 

• Climate control and irrigation management systems. 

• Electrical installations, switchboards, cabling, and LED lighting systems.  

If you have an interest in design and engineering, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and optimization of electrical control panels.

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a degree in Electricity, Electromechanics, or a similar technical field. 

• You enjoy combining hands-on technical work with problem-solving and analytical thinking. 

• You are flexible and enjoy a diverse range of tasks. 

• You work accurately and take ownership of your responsibilities. 

• Experience as a service technician or in technical project work is an asset. 

• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 

• You possess a valid cat B driving license.

As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Professional bachelor’s degree or higher secondary education

• Excellent spoken English, good German and Dutch language skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Strong verbal communication skills, analytical and problem-solving ability

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

Robert Half is currently looking for a PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) for a company located in the Beringen region.

Our client is an international organization with a well-established European hub in Belgium. The company operates in a fast-moving and structured environment, supporting large-scale operations across multiple countries while maintaining a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The responsibilities for this job as PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) include:

• You take on a pan-European finance controlling role within an international finance team.
• You support financial reporting and controlling activities in close collaboration with local and international stakeholders.
• You report directly to the Finance Manager and contribute to the follow-up of key finance processes.
• You help ensure accurate analysis, reporting, and financial follow-up in an English-speaking business environment.
• You contribute to month-end closing activities and are prepared to provide extra support during the first working days of the month.
• You work closely with a small finance team in a multicultural and structured setting.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field, or you bring equivalent relevant experience.
• You have 1 to 5 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Audit, or Controlling.
• You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.
• You combine strong analytical skills with the ability to work independently.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office in your daily work.
• You are a professional and respectful communicator with a strong work ethic.
• You have a mature, proactive, and hands-on mindset.
• You feel comfortable in a structured environment.
• You bring experience with SAP, IFRS, VAT, corporate tax, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or external audits as an advantage.
• You are motivated by working in an international and multicultural environment.

As part of the HR team, you will play a key role in supporting managers and employees on all operational and administrative HR matters. You will act as the first point of contact for Hard HR topics, ensuring compliance with local labour legislation, accuracy of HR data, and smooth execution of HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.This position offers an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who wants to further develop expertise in Belgian labour law, HR administration, payroll coordination, and HR operations.Employee Lifecycle Management

• Manage and coordinate all administrative HR processes from onboarding to offboarding.
• Prepare employment contracts, contract amendments, and other employment-related documents.
• Follow up on employee movements, including promotions, transfers, changes in working time, and organizational changes.
Payroll & Compensation Administration

• Act as the main point of contact for payroll administration and collaborate closely with the payroll provider.
• Follow up on absences, leave requests, time registration, and benefits administration.
• Support compensation and benefits administration and related documentation.
Labor Law & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with Belgian labour legislation, collective labour agreements, and internal policies.
• Monitor legislative changes and support the implementation of required updates.
• Provide first-line guidance to managers and employees on contractual and administrative HR matters.
HR Operations & Data Management

• Maintain accurate employee data in HR systems (Workday and other HR tools).
• Ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and compliance with GDPR requirements.
• Create and maintain HR procedures, policies, templates, and documentation.
Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and administrative efficiency.
• Support the digitalization and automation of HR activities.
Contribute to HR projects related to compliance, employee administration, and operational excellence.

• Master's degree, preferably in Human Resources, Business Administration, Payroll Administration or a related field
• Fluent in Dutch and French, both written and spoken; good command of English
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist, HR operations or payroll-related role
• Good knowledge of local legislation (knowledge of Luxembourg legislation is a plus)
• Good knowledge of Office tools (Outlook, Excel, Power point)
• Knowledge of Workday is a plus
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Strong analytical skills
• Comfortable working with digital HR systems, tools and process automation
• Results oriented
• Good administrative and organizational skills
• Open-minded, autonomous, flexible and proactive
• Able to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!

A selection of your responsibilities:

• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.

• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools.

We are looking for the following profile:

• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
• You are available for a full-time position.

•  

Team: You will join the Regional Shared Service Center (RSSC) for Benelux, a team of 30 accountants. The RSSC serves as an internal pilot within the international group: all accounting and controlling activities are centralized and optimized here.

•

Qualifications
 
 

•  

Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  

•  

Experience: Dynamic accountant with strong experience in General Ledger (GL) accounting, preferably gained in a complex, changing, or international corporate environment.
  

•  

Knowledge & systems:
 
 

•  

In-depth and proven knowledge of BE GAAP and IFRS.
  

•  

Excellent systems knowledge: experience with 
SAP S/4HANA and 
Excel is an absolute must. Knowledge of Power BI is a strong asset.
    

•  

Languages: Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  

•  

Essentials:
 
 

•  

Autonomous, proactive, able to structure your own work, and only satisfied when the result is delivered.
  

•  

Resilient, thriving in a dynamic, transforming environment where structures and processes evolve rapidly.
  

•  

Strong, direct, and open communicator regarding what goes well, but also brave enough to discuss mistakes to learn together.
